description: The file defines a Fragment class for displaying product details in an Android shopping app. It manages UI components such as image galleries, sale badges, price info, and countdown timers, and interacts with repositories for product data and user actions.

classes.name: ProductDetailsFragment
classes.description: A Fragment class in Android that displays detailed information about a product, including images, pricing, sale status, and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and retrieves the product ID from arguments.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up UI components, loads product data, binds data to UI, and manages user interactions.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stops countdown timers when the fragment is paused.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up resources such as countdown timers when the view is destroyed.

methods.name: bindProduct
methods.description: Binds product data to UI elements, manages sale UI, gallery, and specifications display.

methods.name: startCountdownIfNeeded
methods.description: Starts a coroutine to update the sale countdown timer if the product has a sale countdown.

methods.name: isReducedMotionEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether reduced motion settings are enabled for accessibility.

methods.name: updateDots
methods.description: Updates the UI dots to indicate the current gallery image.

methods.name: updateFavoriteUi
methods.description: Updates the favorite button's appearance based on whether the product is marked as favorite.
